title: Zesty Smoky British Sausages Toad In The Hole
description: A classic British dish with a smoky twist, featuring Cornish sausages in a light and flavorful batter, slow-cooked to perfection in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the Cornish sausages to the donabe and cook until browned on all sides.
Pour the batter over the sausages in the donabe.
Transfer the donabe to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the donabe from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
